scope: Two EIA daily spot-price series supplied for factual energy-component context only; not PPI series, forecasts, or market-price analysis.

observations.mapping: Values align by the listed dates. EIA rows have weekday columns Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri; both Sep 8 and Sep 15 are included. Oct 13 is Tuesday; latest actual value in both captures is Oct 14. Oct 15–16 cells were blank at retrieval.

series.name: wti_daily
series.title: Cushing, OK WTI Spot Price FOB (Dollars per Barrel)
series.coverage: 1986-01-02 through 2026-10-14; daily values arranged as Mon–Fri within week rows.

series.name: gulf_gasoline_daily
series.title: U.S. Gulf Coast Conventional Gasoline Regular Spot Price FOB (Dollars per Gallon)
series.coverage: 1986-06-02 through 2026-10-14; daily values arranged as Mon–Fri within week rows.

metric_limits: The pages identify daily spot quotes (WTI Cushing FOB and U.S. Gulf Coast conventional gasoline regular FOB), not BLS final-demand PPI transaction-weighted indexes. They are context only and do not establish pass-through, weights, or October PPI.
No September Tuesday/week-start assumption is made; both Sep 8 and Sep 15 are reported as requested. The October date is the exact Oct 13 observation.
retrieval: Two ordinary public GETs; HTTP 200 each, redirects resolved to the history pages listed above. Request and receipt/body hashes are in the receipt paths; raw bodies were durably gzipped before parsing.
